info.title: belajar.ai
info.description: Accounts, profiles, sessions, subjects, guided lessons, the home screen, conversations and streamed answers for the learning app. Every error body has the same shape: { code, message, requestId, errors? }.

post.summary: Signs a student in. Unknown username and wrong password answer the same body.

200.description: The student, with a fresh session cookie

429.description: Too many failed logins; see Retry-After

204.description: The session is gone; the cookie is cleared

post.summary: Changes the password: the current session survives, every other one ends.

204.description: The password is changed and other sessions are ended

post.summary: Creates a student and signs them in.

201.description: The student, signed in with a session cookie

get.summary: The student's conversations, newest activity first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor of a previous page

post.summary: Starts a conversation, optionally about one subject.

patch.summary: Renames a conversation. A later message never overwrites the new title.

get.summary: The conversation's stored messages, oldest first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor of a previous page

post.summary: Asks a question. The answer streams in as `text/event-stream`.

200.description: SSE events: `message` (the stored question), `delta` per answer piece, then `done` (the stored answer) — or one last `error` with the standard error body

post.summary: `POST /v1/lessons`: starts the chapter's lesson, or resumes the existing one unchanged.

200.description: The lesson already existed and is returned unchanged

patch.summary:
`PATCH /v1/lessons/{id}`: moves the lesson's step. `done` is refused: only completing a quiz
finishes a lesson.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/lessons/{id}/complete`: applies the guided session's quiz result, keeps the best
stars and awards the star ledger rows for newly reached levels.

patch.summary: Updates the nickname and/or the grade. `username` and friends are not editable here.

get.summary: The book page one source cites, with the upstream's own content type.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The message the source belongs to

get.summary: The OpenAPI document for this API.

`GET /v1/subjects`: the upstream's mapel for the student's grade, in our fixed order, under
our ids. A mapel we do not know is left out.

`GET /v1/subjects/{subjectId}/chapters`: the chapter map, joined with the student's own
progress.

ChapterDto.description: One chapter of a subject, with the student's own progress in it.

lessonId.description: The student's lesson for this chapter, when they started one.

stars.description: The best stars the student's quizzes earned in this chapter, 0 when none.

step.description: `null` before the student starts the chapter's lesson, else its current step.

ChaptersDto.description: The chapters list: `{ data, nextCursor }`, one complete page.

ContinueItemDto.description: One unfinished lesson to continue, most recently updated first.

ConversationDto.description: One conversation, as every conversation response shows it.

subjectId.description: Our subject id ("ipa", "mtk", ...) or `null` for "all subjects".

ConversationListDto.description: Every list response: rows plus the cursor the next page needs, `null` on the last page.

ConversationModeDto.description: `ask` is a Tanya conversation, `learn` a Belajar chapter session.

DeltaData.description: One piece of the answer as it streams in.

FieldError.description:
One bad field, named by a JSON Pointer. The `code` vocabulary is the one the plan fixes:
`required`, `too_short`, `too_long`, `invalid_format`, `out_of_range`.

field.description: A JSON Pointer into the body (`/items/0/quantity`), or the name of a query or path parameter.

HomeDto.description: The home screen, everything in one response.

LessonDto.description: One guided lesson, as every lesson response shows it.

LogoutRequest.description: `POST /v1/auth/logout` takes an empty object, so the extractor can tell `{}` from nothing.

MessageDto.description: One stored message: the student's question or the assistant's answer.

MissionDto.description: One daily mission, with today's progress.

PatchLessonRequest.description:
The body of `PATCH /v1/lessons/{id}`. `step` is a string so a bad value is a field error, not
a body parse error.

nickname.description: A `nickname` that is only whitespace is invalid, so `null` is the only "no change" form.

SourceDto.description:
One book passage an answer used. The upstream's `page_url` stays on our server; the browser
fetches the page through `pagePreviewUrl` instead.

number.description: The citation number used in the answer text, e.g. `[1]`.

pagePreviewUrl.description: `/v1/messages/{messageId}/sources/{number}/page` when the page image exists, else `null`.

StudentDto.description: A whole student, as every auth and `/v1/me` response shows them. No password material, ever.

SubjectDto.description: One subject, under our id, with the upstream's name passed back on later requests.

mapel.description: The upstream's own name for this subject ("mapel"), e.g. as sent on chat requests.

SubjectsDto.description: The subjects list: `{ data, nextCursor }`, one complete page.
